citations.quote: The City of Snohomish is soliciting proposals
RFP Title: Information Technology Strategic Plan
Assessment of customer satisfaction, to include interviews with a wide range of City staff.
The City of Snohomish is soliciting proposals from qualified consultant firms to develop a Six-Year Information Technology Strategic Plan.
Deliverables will include (but may not be limited to):
Assess, evaluate, and develop recommendations for a six-year strategic plan

Evaluation of moving to Cloud based technologies, support for mobile computing options, user-experience and usability strategies, storage and backup strategies, and skill levels related to the technologies needed now and needed over the next six years (infrastructure assessment and roadmap).
